status: Proposed host contracts; adapters are not installed by this package
enforcement: Resolve paths inside the authorized workspace and reject traversal
Redact secrets and PII before persistence
Use allowlisted checks, never caller-supplied shell commands
Obtain verified approval records from authenticated host storage, never model-supplied JSON
Bind approval to exact action, target, operational data scope and artifact SHA-256

functions.name: read_project_file
functions.description: Read a bounded UTF-8 project file after workspace and sensitive-path checks.

functions.name: apply_project_patch
functions.description: Apply a reviewed patch to authorized source files; reject environment files, operational databases and protected paths unless specifically authorized.

functions.name: run_check
functions.description: Run a host-owned command preset against disposable fixtures; record exit code, elapsed time and redacted output.

functions.name: request_approval
functions.description: Present a concrete action and artifact for authenticated approval; timeout never means approval.

functions.name: execute_approved_action
functions.description: Host revalidates identity, expiry, scope, artifact and required checks immediately before executing a registered action adapter.
